report.explanation: Alert shows four checkout observations, all HTTP 200, with one 344ms outlier and three at 62-78ms. Traces show all spans 200/ok with no error status; metrics show zero 502s and no dependency failures; logs are all INFO. No evidence establishes any taxonomy cause (500s, pool exhaustion, redis timeout, downstream latency, memory leak, bad config). Single slow request is insufficient to bound a fault; hand off.
missing_evidence: Baseline latency distribution for /v1/checkout to judge whether 344ms is anomalous
Sustained latency/error metrics over a longer window than 60s
Dependency-level latency breakdown (order, inventory, payment, postgres, redis) to localize the slow request
Confirmation whether the 344ms outlier recurs or is a one-off
